title: DinoDental: Benchmarking DINOv3 as a Unified Vision Encoder for Dental Image Analysis
mechanism: Benchmark of DINOv3 as a frozen or tuned encoder on greyscale dental images with scarce labels.
adaptation: Greyscale, low-label transfer evidence; use its frozen vs tuned results to set how deep VFM-H tunes.
min_experiment: No own arm: read results, then fix VFM-H tuning depth (frozen + PEFT vs last-k blocks tuned).
